data.name: Mockolate0001Description
data.value: Verifications of mocks must be used.

data.name: Mockolate0001MessageFormat
data.value: Verifications must be used.

data.name: Mockolate0001Title
data.value: Verifications must be used

data.name: Mockolate0001CodeFixTitle
data.value: Verify at least once.
data.comment: The title of the code fix.

data.name: Mockolate0002Description
data.value: Types that are sealed, structs, records, enums, or in the global namespace cannot be mocked. Neither can types with a member that must be implemented but is not accessible from the current assembly.

data.name: Mockolate0002MessageFormat
data.value: Type '{0}' cannot be mocked: {1}

data.name: Mockolate0002Title
data.value: Mock arguments must be mockable

data.name: Mockolate0003Description
data.value: Members that use a non-span ref struct in a value position - a method or delegate return, a property type, an indexer value - cannot be mocked, and neither can ref-struct parameters on delegate types. Ref-struct parameter mocking (including ref-struct-keyed indexers) is supported, but requires .NET 9 or later.

data.name: Mockolate0003MessageFormat
data.value: Type '{0}' has a member '{1}' that cannot be mocked: {2}

data.name: Mockolate0003Title
data.value: Ref-struct usage is not supported on this compilation

data.name: Mockolate0004Description
data.value: Spellings of a type that differ only in tuple element names or nullable annotations are the same type, so they share one mock. Mocking the type in more than one of these spellings in one compilation is not supported.

data.name: Mockolate0004MessageFormat
data.value: Type '{0}' is also mocked as {1}, which differs only in tuple element names or nullable annotations; use a single spelling

data.name: Mockolate0004Title
data.value: Mocked types must use a single spelling

data.name: Mockolate0005Description
data.value: The logging setups and verifications intercept the calls of ILogger.Log, so the mock of a class that implements ILogger only supports them when the class implements Log with a virtual or abstract method. The logging verifications of a logger factory are only supported on mocks of ILoggerFactory and interfaces that derive from it.

data.name: Mockolate0005MessageFormat
data.value: The logging setups and verifications are not supported on the mock of class '{0}', because it cannot intercept the log calls

data.name: Mockolate0005Title
data.value: Logging setups and verifications need a mock that intercepts the log calls

data.name: Mockolate0006Description
data.value: A lone null or default literal that binds to an IParameters overload is not a null argument. No parameter of the member can be null there, so the literal means any parameters and the setup or verification matches every call.

data.name: Mockolate0006MessageFormat
data.value: '{0}' matches any parameters, not a null argument; use Match.AnyParameters() if that is intended

data.name: Mockolate0006Title
data.value: A null argument for IParameters matches any parameters

data.name: Mockolate0006CodeFixTitle
data.value: Use Match.AnyParameters()
data.comment: The title of the code fix.

data.name: Mockolate0007Description
data.value: A matcher or a parameters match such as Match.AnyParameters() passed to a Setup or Verify parameter that takes a value, for example an object parameter, a params object[] element or the value of a property or indexer verification, is compared as the expected value. The setup or verification then only matches a call that passes an object equal to the matcher.

data.name: Mockolate0007MessageFormat
data.value: '{0}' is compared as a value of type '{1}' instead of matching; {2}

data.name: Mockolate0007Title
data.value: A matcher is compared as a value

data.name: Mockolate0007ValueHint
data.value: use a matcher for '{0}', or It.Is<{0}>(…) if the matcher itself is the expected value
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0007MessageFormat. {0} is the value type.

data.name: Mockolate0007CastHint
data.value: cast it to IParameter<{0}> to pass it as a matcher
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0007MessageFormat for a matcher that is also a value of the value type. {0} is the value type.

data.name: Mockolate0007NoMatcherOverloadHint
data.value: no overload of this member takes it as a matcher
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0007MessageFormat for a matcher whose interface converts to the value type, so that no spelling binds it as a matcher.

data.name: Mockolate0007OtherArgumentsHint
data.value: pass matchers of the parameter types for the other arguments as well, for example It.Is(…)
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0007MessageFormat for a matcher of the value type next to plain values.

data.name: Mockolate0007ParamsArrayHint
data.value: pass the elements as separate arguments instead of an array
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0007MessageFormat for a matcher of the value type in an explicit params array.

data.name: Mockolate0007ParamsArrayAndOtherArgumentsHint
data.value: pass the elements as separate arguments instead of an array, and matchers of the parameter types for the other arguments as well, for example It.Is(…)
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0007MessageFormat for a matcher of the value type in an explicit params array next to plain values.

data.name: Mockolate0007WholeArrayHint
data.value: a matcher for the whole params array only matches the array as its only element, and next to other elements it matches one element
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0007MessageFormat for a matcher for the whole params array of a type parameter next to other elements of the array.

data.name: Mockolate0007ParametersHint
data.value: use a matcher for '{0}', such as It.IsAny<{0}>(); a parameters match only applies as the only argument of a method
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0007MessageFormat for a parameters match such as Match.AnyParameters() or Match.Parameters(…). {0} is the value type.

data.name: Mockolate0010Description
data.value: A parameter of a method, constructor or type with an attribute that implements Mockolate.Internals.IMockDataSource asks for a mock or an instance with mocked dependencies, but Mockolate cannot create its type, so the attribute, such as AutoMockArguments, cannot fill it.

data.name: Mockolate0010MessageFormat
data.value: Mockolate cannot create the parameter '{0}' of type '{1}': {2}

data.name: Mockolate0010Title
data.value: A mock test parameter cannot be created

data.name: Mockolate0010TypeParameterReason
data.value: it is a type parameter

data.name: Mockolate0010InaccessibleReason
data.value: it is not accessible from the generated code

data.name: Mockolate0010ContainsTypeParameterReason
data.value: its type arguments contain a type parameter

data.name: Mockolate0010FileLocalReason
data.value: it is file-local

data.name: Mockolate0010NestedInGenericTypeReason
data.value: it is nested in a generic type

data.name: Mockolate0010ObsoleteReason
data.value: it is obsolete or experimental

data.name: Mockolate0010NotMockableReason
data.value: it cannot be mocked ({0})
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0010MessageFormat. {0} is the reason of Mockolate0002.

data.name: Mockolate0010StaticAbstractReason
data.value: it has static abstract members

data.name: Mockolate0010ParameterlessConstructorReason
data.value: its mock needs an accessible constructor that can be called without arguments, or a single one with the most parameters, which CreateMock() fills

data.name: Mockolate0010GenericClassReason
data.value: it is a generic class

data.name: Mockolate0010ConstructorReason
data.value: it has no single accessible constructor with the most parameters that Mockolate can call

data.name: Mockolate0010TypeArgumentReason
data.value: a type argument or array element is obsolete, experimental, a ref struct, a pointer, nested in a generic type or an interface with static abstract members

data.name: Mockolate0010CreateMockMemberReason
data.value: it has a member named CreateMock, which would hide the generated extension

data.name: Mockolate0010MemberReason
data.value: its mock cannot implement the member '{0}'

data.name: Mockolate0011Description
data.value: An [AsDefault] parameter marks the default value of its type and of the types of the attribute for all mocks of the test case, so it is ambiguous when another [AsDefault] parameter is used for one of these types, must be assignable to each of them, and contradicts a [NotShared] marker, which keeps the parameter from the other arguments.

data.name: Mockolate0011MessageFormat
data.value: The [AsDefault] parameter '{0}' {1}

data.name: Mockolate0011Title
data.value: An [AsDefault] parameter is ambiguous or invalid

data.name: Mockolate0011SameTypeReason
data.value: is used for '{1}' like the [AsDefault] parameter '{0}'
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0011MessageFormat. {0} is the other parameter, {1} the type of both.

data.name: Mockolate0011NotAssignableReason
data.value: is not assignable to '{0}'
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0011MessageFormat. {0} is a type of the attribute.

data.name: Mockolate0011NotSharedReason
data.value: is also marked [NotShared]

data.name: Mockolate0012Description
data.value: A [Deferred] parameter must be a Func<T>, whose calls each create a new T. It is never shared with the classes under test, so [NotShared] has no effect, and the mocks cannot return it as the default value of a type, so it cannot be [AsDefault].

data.name: Mockolate0012MessageFormat
data.value: The [Deferred] parameter '{0}' {1}

data.name: Mockolate0012Title
data.value: A [Deferred] parameter is invalid

data.name: Mockolate0012NotAFuncReason
data.value: is not a Func<T>

data.name: Mockolate0012AsDefaultReason
data.value: is also marked [AsDefault]

data.name: Mockolate0012NotSharedReason
data.value: is also marked [NotShared], which has no effect

data.name: Mockolate0014Description
data.value: The memory cache setups and verifications need a mock that behaves like a cache, so the mock of a class that implements IMemoryCache only supports them when TryGetValue, CreateEntry and Remove are abstract. Otherwise the mock calls the base implementations.

data.name: Mockolate0014MessageFormat
data.value: The memory cache setups and verifications are not supported on the mock of class '{0}', because it calls the base implementations of TryGetValue, CreateEntry or Remove

data.name: Mockolate0014Title
data.value: Memory cache setups and verifications need a mock that behaves like a cache

data.name: Mockolate0013Description
data.value: A [ValueFrom] parameter takes its value from a static property or parameterless static method of the test class or a non-private one of its base classes, whose type must be assignable to the parameter. A field is not supported, because it would share one instance with all test cases. A given argument of the attribute replaces the value, and a [Deferred] marker contradicts it.

data.name: Mockolate0013MessageFormat
data.value: The [ValueFrom] parameter '{0}' {1}

data.name: Mockolate0013Title
data.value: A [ValueFrom] parameter is invalid

data.name: Mockolate0013NotFoundReason
data.value: names no static property or parameterless static method '{0}' of '{1}'
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0013MessageFormat. {0} is the member name, {1} the test class.

data.name: Mockolate0013FieldReason
data.value: names the field '{0}' of '{1}'; use a property or method, so that each test case gets a new value
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0013MessageFormat. {0} is the member name, {1} the test class.

data.name: Mockolate0013NotStaticReason
data.value: names '{0}', which is not static
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0013MessageFormat. {0} is the member name.

data.name: Mockolate0013NotAssignableReason
data.value: names '{0}' of type '{1}', which is not assignable to '{2}'
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0013MessageFormat. {0} is the member name, {1} its type, {2} the parameter type.

data.name: Mockolate0013DeferredReason
data.value: is also marked [Deferred]

data.name: Mockolate0013GivenArgumentReason
data.value: gets a given argument of the attribute, which replaces the value

data.name: Mockolate0014Description
data.value: An attribute that implements IParameterValueProvider provides the value of a test parameter. When the attribute declares the types of its values with [ProvidesValuesFor], one of them must be assignable to the parameter. A parameter can have only one value provider or [ValueFrom]. A given argument of the attribute replaces the value, and a [Deferred] marker contradicts it.

data.name: Mockolate0014MessageFormat
data.value: The parameter '{0}' {1}

data.name: Mockolate0014Title
data.value: A parameter with a value provider is invalid

data.name: Mockolate0014NotProvidedReason
data.value: has the value provider '{0}', which provides only values of type {1}
data.comment: Completes Mockolate0014MessageFormat. {0} is the attribute, {1} the quoted types of its [ProvidesValuesFor].

data.name: Mockolate0014MultipleReason
data.value: has more than one value provider or [ValueFrom]

data.name: Mockolate0014DeferredReason
data.value: has a value provider and is also marked [Deferred]

data.name: Mockolate0014GivenArgumentReason
data.value: gets a given argument of the attribute, which replaces the value of its value provider

data.name: AsDefaultSuppressionJustification
data.value: The other mocks of the test case may return the [AsDefault] parameter.
data.comment: The justification of the suppressions Mockolate1001 (IDE0060) and Mockolate1002 (xUnit1026).

data.name: UnionArgumentCodeFixTitle
data.value: Add the explicit type '{0}'
data.comment: The title of the code fix for an argument that cannot convert to a union-typed setup or verify parameter.
